About.heroSubtitle: RestoMind is an AI-driven surplus food ecosystem. We empower restaurants and bakeries to accurately predict food waste, while allowing local customers to rescue delicious meals at incredible prices.
About.missionTitle: Fighting Food Waste Through Smart Prediction & Sharing
About.missionDesc: Every single day, tons of fresh, high-quality food from local bakeries and dining spots are thrown away simply due to overproduction. RestoMind fixes this by combining predictive AI intelligence with a community surplus marketplace.
About.dualSubtitle: A unified platform bringing together smart food vendors and conscious food lovers.
About.forCustomersSubtitle: Rescue Fresh Food & Save Up to 70%
About.forCustomersDesc: Browse real-time discounted daily offers from your favorite neighborhood bakeries, cafes, and restaurants. Order easily online and pick up or receive fresh surplus bags while enjoying premium food for less.
About.forVendorsDesc: Restaurants and bakeries can register a merchant account to access our AI waste prediction dashboard. Forecast unsold items in advance, list surplus inventory as daily offers, recover lost costs, and attract new customers.
About.aiSubtitle: Cutting-edge machine learning for food sustainability
About.aiDesc: Our proprietary AI models analyze historical demand, day-of-week trends, weather patterns, and foot traffic to help kitchen managers forecast daily surplus before items are baked or cooked.
About.valuesSubtitle: Our core principles guide every line of code and every vendor partnership.
About.value1Desc: No fresh food should ever end up in a landfill when someone nearby could enjoy it.
About.value2Desc: Making high-quality restaurant and bakery meals accessible to everyone at affordable prices.
About.value3Desc: Empowering food merchants with smart analytics to optimize daily production schedules.
About.ctaDesc: Join thousands of customers saving on daily meals and hundreds of restaurants reducing food waste.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro: Welcome to RestoMind. By accessing our platform as a customer or registering as a food vendor, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. Please review them carefully.
Terms.section1Body: RestoMind operates an online platform connecting food vendors (restaurants, bakeries, cafes) with consumers. Merchants use our AI-assisted waste prediction tools to list surplus food items at discounted prices, enabling consumers to purchase and rescue fresh surplus meals.
Terms.section2Body: Participating restaurants and bakeries are solely responsible for food preparation, hygiene standards, accurate allergen labeling, and ensuring that all surplus items listed on RestoMind are safe, wholesome, and compliant with local health and food safety regulations.
Terms.section3Body: Customers understand that surplus offers and 'Surplus Surprise Bags' consist of fresh, unsold daily inventory. Items are offered subject to real-time store availability. All orders placed are subject to merchant confirmation and stock availability.
Terms.section4Body: For store pickup orders, customers must arrive within the designated store pickup window. For home delivery orders, delivery timelines depend on partner logistics. Uncollected pickup orders within specified windows may be forfeited without refund.
Terms.section5Body: All prices listed on RestoMind include applicable taxes. Payments are processed securely via authorized gateways. Due to the perishable nature of surplus food, refunds are issued primarily for unfulfilled orders, missing items, or verified quality issues reported within 2 hours of delivery/pickup.
Terms.section6Body: Users and merchants must maintain accurate account information and secure passwords. RestoMind reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts engaging in fraudulent activities, fake orders, or violation of community standards.
Terms.section7Body: RestoMind retains all rights to its AI waste prediction software, branding, UI designs, and platform algorithms. Merchants are granted a non-exclusive license to access the prediction dashboard for operational purposes.
Terms.section8Body: We may update these terms periodically to reflect service improvements or legal requirements. Material changes will be communicated via in-app notifications or registered email.
Terms.section9Body: If you have questions regarding these Terms & Conditions or vendor agreements, please contact our support team at legal@restomind.com.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At RestoMind, we value your trust. This Privacy Policy details how we collect, use, protect, and handle personal data for customers and food vendor partners.
Privacy.section1Body: We collect information required to operate our service: personal details (name, email, phone number), delivery addresses, order history, payment transaction references (processed via secure PCI-compliant gateways), and merchant operational metrics for AI waste forecasting.
Privacy.section2Body: Customer data is used to process orders, manage deliveries, send order updates, and provide personalized surplus recommendations. Vendor data is processed by our AI algorithms to calculate waste predictions and optimize production schedules.
Privacy.section3Body: We do not sell personal data. Necessary order data (delivery address, contact phone, order contents) is shared strictly with fulfilling restaurants and delivery partners to complete your order.
Privacy.section4Body: Surplus data and consumption patterns may be aggregated and anonymized to train our AI waste prediction models, improve demand forecasting, and generate food waste reduction impact reports.
Privacy.section5Body: We employ industry-standard encryption protocols (SSL/TLS), strict database access controls, and security monitoring. We retain user data for as long as your account remains active or as required by law.
Privacy.section6Body: We use essential session cookies and performance analytics cookies to store language preferences (English/Arabic), theme settings, and active cart state. You can control cookie preferences in your browser.
Privacy.section7Body: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal account information at any time via Profile settings or by contacting privacy@restomind.com.
Privacy.section8Body: RestoMind is intended for users aged 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect or store personal data from minors.
Privacy.section9Body: For any questions or data protection inquiries, email our Data Protection Officer at privacy@restomind.com.
